news_analysis.headline_hook: Global sell-off-la stock market panic-a? SIP holders, check your 22,725 Nifty resistance level.
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Indian benchmark indices opened higher in early trade, with the Sensex rising over 370 points to 73,154 and the Nifty climbing 103 points to 22,725. This occurred even as regional peers faced steep declines, with Korea's Kospi dropping over 7% and Japan's Nikkei declining 4%.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Assuming an early morning gap-up indicates complete decoupling from global headwinds and aggressive selling across Asian markets.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Early trade gains reflect initial opening momentum, but the broader backdrop shows significant global pressure stemming from US inflation figures and weakness in AI stocks that may introduce volatility throughout the session.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Check whether early trade momentum sustains through the trading day before deploying capital, rather than chasing opening gains during severe global market downturns.

deck.caption:
Global markets raththa kaada irundhaalum, namma Sensex early trade-la over 370 points gap-up aayirukku. FOMO-la jump panna poringala illa wait panni reality paaka poringala? US inflation data-vaala Kospi 7% and Nikkei 4% plunge aagirukku. Early momentum sustain aagalana afternoon sell-off varalam. Nifty 22,725 resistance sustain aagudha-nu paarthutu capital deploy panradhe safe approach. Neenga ipdi gap-up aagum bodhu buy pannuveengala illa afternoon varai wait pannuveengala? Comments-la sollunga!
